medical_fields.description: Primary healthcare Q&A, comprehensive consultations, wellness screenings, and medication management.
safety_tips: Stay hydrated and eat balanced meals.
medical_fields.emergency_guidance: If experiencing severe confusion, high fever with stiff neck, or extreme lethargy, call emergency response.

medical_fields.description: Heart and cardiovascular system care, blood pressure monitoring, and cardiac risk assessment.
safety_tips: Engage in 30 mins moderate daily cardio.
symptoms_and_warnings: Pain radiating to jaw or left arm
medical_fields.emergency_guidance: CHEST PAIN EMERGENCY: Crushing chest pain or pressure requires IMMEDIATE emergency assistance (Dial 911 / 112).

medical_fields.description: Skin, hair, and nail health, rash evaluation, acne treatment, and lesion monitoring.
safety_tips: Avoid picking or popping inflammatory acne.
Monitor changes in mole size and shape (ABCDE rule).
symptoms_and_warnings: Skin lesions that bleed or change color
medical_fields.emergency_guidance: Sudden widespread skin blistering or facial swelling with difficulty breathing requires immediate emergency care.

medical_fields.description: Oral hygiene, tooth pain evaluation, gum disease treatment, and dental preventive procedures.
safety_tips: Brush twice daily with fluoride toothpaste.
medical_fields.emergency_guidance: Facial swelling spreading to eye or neck from tooth infection is an emergency; seek immediate hospital or dental triage.

medical_fields.description: Comprehensive health, growth tracking, and vaccination management for infants, children, and adolescents.
safety_tips: Keep childhood vaccination schedules up to date.
Store all medicines in childproof locked cabinets.
symptoms_and_warnings: High fever in infants under 3 months
medical_fields.emergency_guidance: High fever in newborns (< 90 days) or severe respiratory distress in infants requires urgent ER evaluation.

medical_fields.description: Women’s reproductive health, menstrual disorders, prenatal guidance, and hormonal wellness.
safety_tips: Schedule annual Pap smear screenings as recommended.
medical_fields.emergency_guidance: Severe lower abdominal pain with fainting or heavy pregnancy bleeding requires immediate emergency transport.

medical_fields.description: Bone, joint, ligament, and skeletal system diagnosis, fracture care, and arthritis management.
safety_tips: Maintain calcium and Vitamin D intake.
symptoms_and_warnings: Inability to bear weight on limb
medical_fields.emergency_guidance: Open fractures or limb numbness after trauma are medical emergencies; immobilize limb and call emergency response.

medical_fields.description: Rehabilitation therapy, post-surgical recovery, spinal mobility, and ergonomic alignment.
safety_tips: Take regular movement breaks during desk work.
symptoms_and_warnings: Loss of bowel/bladder control with back pain
medical_fields.emergency_guidance: Sudden loss of bowel or bladder control with back pain may indicate Cauda Equina Syndrome; seek emergency ER care immediately.

medical_fields.description: Mental health assessment, mood regulation, anxiety treatment, and psychological support.
safety_tips: Reach out for professional support early.
medical_fields.emergency_guidance: If experiencing suicidal crisis or acute panic breakdown, immediately contact the Suicide & Crisis Lifeline (988) or emergency services.

medical_fields.description: Brain, spinal cord, and nerve disorder evaluation, migraine care, and seizure management.
safety_tips: Protect head with helmets during biking.
symptoms_and_warnings: Loss of vision in one eye
medical_fields.emergency_guidance: STROKE ALERT: Sudden facial drooping, arm weakness, or slurred speech requires IMMEDIATE stroke center emergency care.

medical_fields.description: Respiratory system health, lung function testing, asthma guidance, and COPD therapy.
safety_tips: Use rescue inhalers exactly as prescribed.
Get annual flu and pneumococcal vaccines.
symptoms_and_warnings: Inability to speak in full sentences due to breathlessness
medical_fields.emergency_guidance: Severe asthma attack with blue lips or gasping for air is a lifethreatening emergency. Call 911 immediately.

medical_fields.description: Digestive system, liver, stomach, and bowel disease diagnosis and nutritional absorption care.
safety_tips: Avoid lying down for 2 hours post-meal.
medical_fields.emergency_guidance: Vomiting blood or severe right-lower quadrant stomach pain (possible appendicitis) requires emergency room triage.

medical_fields.description: Kidney health, filtration monitoring, electrolyte balance, and chronic kidney disease management.
safety_tips: Drink 2 to 2.5 liters of water daily.
Control blood sugar and blood pressure.
symptoms_and_warnings: Severe flank pain radiating to groin
medical_fields.emergency_guidance: Sudden complete absence of urine output or severe excruciating flank pain needs immediate emergency evaluation.

medical_fields.description: Urinary tract, bladder, and male reproductive health evaluation and minimally invasive procedures.
safety_tips: Complete the full course of prescribed antibiotics.
Do not hold urine for extended periods.
Maintain prostate health checks after age 50.
symptoms_and_warnings: High fever with severe chills and flank pain
medical_fields.emergency_guidance: Acute urinary retention (unable to urinate despite fullness) is an emergency requiring catheter relief.

medical_fields.description: Cancer screening, chemotherapy guidance, side-effect management, and supportive oncology care.
safety_tips: Adhere strictly to oncologic appointment schedules.
medical_fields.emergency_guidance: Neutropenic fever during chemotherapy is a medical emergency requiring urgent IV antibiotics at the hospital.

medical_fields.description: Eye care, vision testing, glaucoma screening, cataract evaluation, and retinal health.
safety_tips: Wear protective eyewear during hazardous activities.
Get annual dilated eye exams if diabetic.
symptoms_and_warnings: Flashes of light or shower of floaters
Severe eye pain with redness and halos
medical_fields.emergency_guidance: Sudden vision loss or flashes/curtain over vision (retinal detachment / acute glaucoma) requires emergency eye surgery triage.

medical_fields.description: Ear, Nose, and Throat diagnostics, sinus management, hearing evaluation, and voice care.
safety_tips: Never insert cotton swabs deep into ear canals.
Humidify room air during sinus infections.
symptoms_and_warnings: Inability to swallow saliva due to throat swelling
medical_fields.emergency_guidance: Throat swelling causing difficulty swallowing or breathing is an airway emergency. Call 911 immediately.

medical_fields.description: Hormone balance, thyroid disorder management, blood sugar control, and metabolic health.
safety_tips: Take thyroid medications on an empty stomach in the morning.
medical_fields.emergency_guidance: Diabetic Ketoacidosis (DKA) or unresponsiveness from low blood sugar requires immediate emergency glucagon/ER care.

medical_fields.description: Clinical nutrition counseling, meal planning for chronic diseases, weight management, and deficiency care.
safety_tips: Consult a dietitian for custom therapeutic diets.
symptoms_and_warnings: Rapid involuntary weight loss > 10% in 1 month
medical_fields.emergency_guidance: Severe dehydration or electrolyte crash needs urgent IV rehydration.

medical_fields.description: First-aid protocols, trauma triage, acute resuscitation guidance, and emergency transport coordination.
safety_tips: Maintain a certified Home First-Aid Kit.
symptoms_and_warnings: Severe chest pain or stroke signs
medical_fields.emergency_guidance: FOR ALL LIFE-THREATENING EMERGENCIES: IMMEDIATELY DIAL LOCAL EMERGENCY HOTLINE (911 / 112 / 102).
